history.summary: Shiva temple at Belarahi village, Jhanjharpur subdivision, Madhubani district, locally known as Gaurishankar Mahadev Sthan and Baba Dhaneshwar Nath Mahadev Mandir; described as an ancient (pauranik) temple whose present architecture was built in 1844, with inscriptions in Mithilakshara (Tirhuta script). Bihar's tourism department visited in 2024 to assess tourism potential. IDENTITY/TOWN FLAG: CSV lists 'Gaurishankar Temple, Darbhanga' - no Darbhanga-city temple by this name has a documented web footprint; this Belarahi shrine, explicitly 'also known as Gaurishankar Mahadev Sthan', is the most likely referent, but it is in Madhubani district (Jhanjharpur), not Darbhanga. Coordinates from Wikipedia/GeoHack. No reliable on-topic image found after genuine searching - media left empty.

town_description: Jhanjharpur is a subdivision town in Madhubani district, Bihar, in the Mithila region. The temple stands in Belarahi village nearby.
